title: castilleja rubra
intro: Castilleja rubra, commonly known as Indian paintbrush, is a flowering plant native to the western and central regions of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Castilleja rubra include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Castilleja rubra include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
